base: research/phase2_anchor_step_20261013 (events.py reused unchanged; M4 = its M4_main)
exposure_note: EXPOSED-EXPLORATORY. Before registration the following were computed on the same data: per-month step decomposition (25 C drop, 25->45 bridge, 45 C drop), phase-matched 45 C end-of-month differences and anchor-to-anchor dQ for CK3-CK7, causal A4 beta (1.03/1.16/1.34/1.37 for CK4-7), and hand errors for beta=1 and causal beta on CK4-7. Results are not blind; CK1-CK3 rules below were fixed without computing their v2 errors.

notation.month m: steps with CK_m < t_cv_end < CK_(m+1), CK dates from dataset.eval_points
notation.anchor_j: first full charge after CK_j (events.full_charges); Q_anchor_0 = 100.41, Q_anchor_j = Q_fc_j + eps for j>=1
notation.E45(m): last 45 C step (step_mean, main method) in month m
notation.d(m): days from E45(m) t_cv_end to CK_(m+1) date 00:00

V2_main.phase_matched_branch: if E45(k-1) exists AND month k-2 has a complete 45 C segment (>=3 steps at 45 C) AND d(k-2) <= 10 days: Q = Q_anchor_(k-1) + beta_k * [E45(k-1) - E45(k-2) + r * (d(k-1) - d(k-2))]
V2_main.rate_r: Theil-Sen slope (Ah/day) of 45 C steps in month k-1 if >=3 such steps, else 0
V2_main.beta_k: shrinkage: beta = (tau*beta0 + S*b_ls)/(tau + S); b_ls = sum(dQ*dT)/sum(dT^2), S = sum(dT^2); dQ_j = Q_fc_j - Q_fc_1, dT_j = T_j - T_1 for visible 25 C anchors j=2..k-1; T = step_to_top_mean of events.charge_step_split(smooth_Ah=2.0); beta0 = 1.0, tau = 1.0 Ah^2; no pairs -> beta0

variants.V2_beta_all: beta_k also applied to the fallback (M4) difference
variants.V2_beta_direct: beta from past phase-matched pairs: LS through origin of (Q_fc_j - Q_fc_(j-1)) on [E45(j-1)-E45(j-2)] for visible valid j, shrunk with same beta0/tau

proxy: P_k = Q_fc_k + eps, eps in {eps0, eps0+0.4, eps0+0.8}, eps0 = 100.41 - Q_fc_0 (same as base study)

gates.H1_causal: candidate output bit-identical when rows after each cutoff are replaced by noise, and when fit() sees only data up to CK1
gates.H2_proxy: for every eps: V2_main MAE < M4 MAE and V2_main MAX <= M4 MAX + 0.10 pp
gates.H3_eps_free: CK2-CK7 eps-free MAE of V2_main <= M4 - 0.05 pp
gates.H4_robust: V2_main MAE < M4 MAE (eps0+0.4) in >=5 of 6 step methods, and in every tau and valid_days setting
gates.H5_no_large_regression: no checkup worse than M4 by more than 0.30 pp (eps0+0.4)
gates.H6_reimplementation: candidate class equals research V2_main within 0.001 pp

adoption: V2 replaces M4 in my_model only if H1-H6 all pass AND the user approves; otherwise report and keep M4.

amendment_1.when: 2026-10-13, before any V2 code was written or run
amendment_1.month_membership: month m = steps with t_cv_end >= anchor_m.t_end and (t_cv_end < anchor_(m+1).t_start if that anchor is visible). Reason: the 2025-02-08 01:xx 45 C step belongs to segment 1 before the post-CK1 anchor; CK-date membership would misplace it.
amendment_1.d(m): days from E45(m) t_cv_end to CK_(m+1) date 00:00 (may be slightly negative)
amendment_1.current_end_phase: phase-matched branch additionally requires d(k-1) <= valid_days OR r estimable (>=3 45 C steps in month k-1). Reason: symmetric end-phase requirement; without it a value 22 days before the checkup would be used with r=0.
